findings.problem: Stop validation still accepted contradictions with the W2 state machine: exit_before_request=true, returncode_before_request=0, last_observed_stage other than the hold, reason swapped between cancel/timeout, and reachability other than reached.
findings.fix: Require exit_before_request=false, returncode_before_request=null, last_observed_stage=before_publish, reason equal to the case kind, and reachability=reached in addition to the existing cause/method/kill/reap/time/exit checks.
findings.negatives: Five new mutations (exit-before, returncode-before, wrong last stage, swapped reason, not reached) all fail with stop_not_confirmed; the two existing cancel/timeout cases are checked.

findings.problem: The Gate-captured quality.json was not supplied as bytes, so only 42 of 43 captures could be independently verified from the package.
findings.fix: Copy the exact Gate capture to gate-captured-quality.json, prove it equals the candidate-commit blob, and record its size/SHA256 and the later docs-only delta.

native_refresh.reason: The verifier is part of the recorded Native source identity, so the real-WIC record was regenerated rather than edited.

gate_and_review: Changed verifier source requires its own pinned Gate pair and fresh review; previous pairs remain under review-round1-* and this round's pair separately.
